notes.title: FREEDOM WARS Remastered - Gameplay Tips
notes.content:
Welcome to the world of FREEDOM WARS REMASTER!

As you embark on your journey through this thrilling game, you'll encounter various challenges and opportunities to showcase your skills. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer, mastering the game's mechanics and strategies is essential for success. In this series of articles, we'll share invaluable tips to help you navigate the complexities of Freedom Wars Remaster and enhance your gameplay experience. This first article focuses on Battle Tips, while the subsequent articles will cover Companion Tips and Other Tips. From reviving allies with Thorns to choosing the best companions for your missions, these tips will give you the edge you need to thrive in the Panopticon.

Tip No. 1 
"Reviving with Thorns"
When an ally or Accessory is downed, instead of getting closer to interact with them directly, you can also launch your Thorn from a distance to revive them.

Forcibly rushing towards your ally might result in both of you getting killed, so make sure to revive your allies using you Thorn whenever you have some Will'O to spare.
[previewyoutube=LmCfoO4_NSM;full]https://youtu.be/LmCfoO4_NSM
[/previewyoutube]

Tip No. 2 
"Replenishing Will'O"
The blue glowing objects scattered throughout the maps are imbued with Will'O.

In fact, you can instantly recover your gauge by shooting your Thorn at these objects.

Always be on the lookout for any spots around you where you can recover Will'O to maintain your mobility.
[previewyoutube=YHmXqNdaT3o;full][/previewyoutube]

Tip No. 3 
"Thorn Cancels"
There's a fixed recovery time period after performing close-range attacks. However, you can cancel that animation by launching a Thorn right after performing an action.

This is an essential technique that allows you to string together quick ""close-range attack→Thorn         launch→close-range attack"" combos.

Use this Thorn cancelling technique as you battle the Abductors.
[previewyoutube=1jflzrbOyAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Tip No. 4 
"Dash Cancels"
You can cancel a Dash instantly by pressing the Use Item button when you have no items ready at your disposal.

This can be used to ""Dash→Use empty item→String close-range attacks together"", making it possible to get closer to the enemies quickly and charge at them with close-range attacks. 

Try out this technique on fallen Large Abductors.
[previewyoutube=Hxq7rDqvWtI;full] https://youtu.be/Hxq7rDqvWtI[/previewyoutube]

Tip No. 5 
"Aiming Tips"
You will need to aim manually at the enemies before shooting when equipping long-range weapons. However, you can make sure to hit an enemy automatically by shooting while holding that enemy with your Thorn. 

Make sure to try this approach and use your Thorn on fast enemies that are hard to hit with long-range weapons.
[previewyoutube=UBj2flQdpb0;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope these Battle Tips for FREEDOM WARS REMASTER help you become a more effective and strategic player. By utilizing techniques like Thorn Cancels and Dash Cancels, and selecting the right companions for your operations, you'll be well-equipped to tackle any challenge the game throws at you. Remember, every mission is an opportunity to improve and refine your skills. Stay tuned for our upcoming articles on Companion Tips and Other Tips to further enhance your gameplay. Gear up, stay vigilant, and make your mark in the Panopticon.

Happy gaming, and may your freedom be within reach!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3004100/FREEDOM_WARS_Remastered/

notes.title: FREEDOM WARS Remastered – June 12 Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of “FREEDOM WARS Remastered.
We would like to inform you about the details of the update released on June 12th. 

【Update Details】 
▼Applicable Platforms 
PS5®, PS4®, Nintendo Switch™, and Steam® versions of “FREEDOM WARS Remastered.” 

▼Versions 
PS4®: 01.09 
PS5®: 01.009.000 
Nintendo Switch™: 1.9.0 
Steam®: 1.09 

▼Updated Content 
■Bug Fixes 
・Cage destruction cutscene may be skipped when destroyed by severing 
Fixed the bug causing the destruction animation to skip when the bird cage trapping a citizen is severed with Light Melee or Flare Knife.  

・Some Special Operations disappear from the Contributions Directory 
Fixed the bug preventing Special Operations XX300–310 from being displayed on the Contributions Directory after certain actions. 

・ Improved Game Stability 
Implemented measures to enhance the stability of the game's performance. 

・Other bug fixes 
Fixed other miscellaneous bugs. 

■Specification Adjustments/Changes 
・Added a new rank option in Vs. Operations 
Added an option ""Any"" to the rank settings in Vs. Operations, allowing players to match with opponents regardless of rank. 

・Adjusted a parameter of some Phalanx-type variant weapons 
Expanded the range of magazine capacity bonus for the Phalanx-type variant Autocannons. 

We appreciate your continued support of “FREEDOM WARS Remastered.

notes.title: PATCH 1.08 – Update Notice
notes.content:
【FREEDOM WARS Remastered – Patch Note Update (April 30, 2025)】
Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS REMASTERED.
We’d like to share the details of the update released on April 30.

▼Applicable Platforms
Steam® version of FREEDOM WARS Remastered

▼Version
Steam®：1.08

▼Update Contents
■Bug Fixes
・Fixed Bug Causing Unresponsiveness When Accessing Volunteer Guidance Requests
Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unresponsive when attempting to access the Volunteer Guidance Request from the cell monitor.

・ Adjusted Invincibility Frames During Evasion with Autocannons
Fixed a bug where invincibility frames during evasion were unintentionally extended when using Autocannons.

・ Fixed Bug Where Thorn Ejection Could Skip Cutscenes
Fixed a bug where the Thorn Ejection button could unintentionally skip all in-battle camera cutscenes, such as those triggered when downing an Abductor.

・ Fixed Bug Where Lock-On Was Cancelled During Spear Attacks
Fixed a bug where the lock-on would be disengaged when performing a weak attack with a spear while locked onto an enemy.

・ Fixed Bug Where Accessory Loadout Deletion Caused Incorrect Display
Fixed a bug where deleting an accessory loadout in "Contribution Guidance Request > Appearance/Body Modification Records" would leave the accessory's loadout name visible while incorrectly deleting the Sinner's loadout name.

・ Fixed Bug Where Destination Icon Remained After Operation Completion
Fixed a bug where the destination icon would remain displayed after completing the operation "DO: XX8-5: Liquidation"

・ Fixed Bug Where Skip Button Displayed as Thorn Ejection Button During Battles
Fixed a bug where the skip prompt during skippable battle cutscenes was incorrectly displayed as the Thorn Ejection button.

・【Steam】Fixed Bug Where Gamepad Inputs Were Incorrect
Fixed a bug where improper inputs could occur when using a gamepad, such as difficulty controlling movement with the analog stick.

・ Improved Game Stability
Fixed several crash-related bugs to improve overall game stability.

・ Fixed Other Bugs
Fixed other bugs.

■Specification adjustments/changes
・ Ajusted Burn Damage
Increased the damage dealt by the Burn status effect, triggered by accumulated fire-based attacks.

・ Adjusted Tracking Performance of Artificial Abductors’ Weapons
Adjusted the tracking performance of "H Missile Pod" and "Guided Missile Launcher" armaments used by Artificial Abductors.

・ Adjusted Accessory Behavior to Improve Hit Detection with Certain Weapons
Adjusted the behavior of Accessories equipped with Igel-series weapons to improve hit accuracy, as attacks would often land short of the target.

・ Adjusted Weapon Balance
-Murasame Series: Increased movement speed.
-Murasame & Damascus Knife Series: Increased damage for weak attack combos and downward slash in vertical spinning attacks.
-AAW Series: Decreased damage multiplier and blast radius in PvP; increased ammo replenishment rate.
-Igel Series: Increased magazine capacity, maximum ammo capacity, ammo replenishment rate, movement speed, and damage multiplier in PvP; attacks can now hit multiple parts.
-Blaster Series: Increased power, stagger damage, blast radius, headshot multiplier, and damage multiplier in PvP.
-Phalanx Series: Increased magazine capacity and maximum ammo capacity.
-Enryu Series: Adjusted to reduce the likelihood of bullets hitting the ground immediately after firing.
-Nambu Series: Adjusted to reduce the likelihood of bullets hitting the ground immediately after firing. Also, increased power and maximum lock-on count.
-Creamy Series: Increased magazine capacity and maximum ammo capacity.
-Mutated Weapons (Ammo Replenishment Rate): Significantly increased mutation parameters.

・ Adjusted Part Break and Acquisition Rewards for General-Purpose Artificial Abductors
Adjusted the resource grades (A/B/C/D) obtained from part breaks and part pickups on Standard Bipedal and Quadrupedal Artificial Abductors to match the level of the target Abductor.

・ Adjusted GDPP Earned in PvP Operations
Adjusted the amount of GDPP earned on the results screen of PvP operations.

・ Added Dash Function Option
Added an option to enable or disable dashing by holding down the evade button, located under "Sinner Management Menu > Options > Other Settings."

・ Relaxed Requirements for Temporary Accessory Selection
Changed the feature so that temporary accessories—previously only usable when your own accessory was abducted—can now be freely used in any operation where accessories can accompany you.
Note: Temporary Accessories = Accessories of players who have exchanged Fellow Cards.

・ Added TIPS Viewing Function
Added a function to view TIPS from "Accessory Services > Education Program Review Request.

・ Changed Display Format of Modular Selection Screen
Changed the display format of the Modular Selection Screen so that if you possess multiple modulars of the same type, they will be grouped together by type.

・ Changed Sort Function in Equipment Customization Screen
Changed the sorting function in the Equipment Customization Screen so that when sorting by "Category," the items are now sorted by weapon series instead of alphabetically by weapon name.

Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.

notes.title: PATCH 1.07 – Update Notice
notes.content:
【April 4 – FREEDOM WARS Remastered Update Notice】
Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.
We would like to inform you about the contents of the update released on April 4.

【Update Details】
▼Applicable Platforms
Steam® versions of FREEDOM WARS Remastered

▼Version Information
Steam®: 1.07

▼Update Contents
■Bug fixes
・【PS4/PS5/Steam】 Adjustments to the Mobility of the Biped  Abductor
A bug that caused unintended speeds for the movement of Biped Abductors has been fixed.

・【PS4/PS5/Steam】 Adjustments to the Peltatum's Suction Attack
A bug that caused unintended amount of movement for Suction Attacks of Peltatum-type has been fixed.

・Unable to Transition to Charge Attacks Immediately After Dashing
A bug where you couldn't transition to charge attacks immediately after dashing when using Heavy Melee or Polearms has been fixed.

・Fixed Modular Selection Bug
Personal Firearm: A bug where an invalid modular (increased fire rate) could be selected has been fixed for the Pulsar system.

・Adjustments to Item Drop Behavior
A bug where enemy drop items in Operation 7-4 could disappear after being dropped has been fixed.

・Fixed Bug with Unacquired Weapons Being Notified
A bug where unacquired weapons were incorrectly notified upon destroying weaponry on certain Large Abductors has been fixed.

・Adjustments to Ally NPC Behavior
A bug where ally NPCs would continuously miss with their thorns has been fixed.

・Fixed Bug with Lock-On Sound Effect Persisting
A bug where the lock-on sound effect would persist in certain situations when using Nambu-type weapons has been fixed.

・Correction of Spanish Text
When the display language was set to Spanish, some material names were incorrectly displayed as those of different materials. This has been corrected.
“Fibra de Will’O: Artillero” -> “Motor de Will’O: Artillero”

・Other Bug Fixes
Other bugs have been fixed.

■Adjustments/Changes to Specifications
・Addition of "Citizen" Tab to Application for Sentence Reduction screen
A "Citizen" tab has been added to Application for Sentence Reduction. (※GDPP at the time of Citizen donation will be zero.)

・Enhanced Severing Damage
The damage from severing attacks has been strengthened. Additionally, the performance difference between button mashing and holding the button has been adjusted to be almost equivalent.

・Permanent Availability of Retribution Volunteer
A "Special Volunteer Dispatch Lottery Terminal" has been added to the cooperative volunteer rooms, allowing players to use the Entitlement Points to obtain the Retribution Volunteer.

・Eased Difficulty in Acquiring limited Exclusive Resources for Retribution Volunteer
A new selection of resources available for purchase from Ethan at Level 6 has been added.

・Weapon Balance Adjustments
Balance adjustments have been made for SR, AR, Phalanx, Pulsar, and Dragonfang weapons:
SR: Headshot multiplier and magazine capacity have been strengthened.
AR: Flinch damage and the impact of attribute values have been strengthened.
Pulsar: The impact of attribute values has been strengthened.
Phalanx: The impact of attribute values has been strengthened.
Dragonfang: Power, headshot multiplier, and maximum magazine capacity have been strengthened.
※Weapon adjustments are planned for future patches as well.

・Addition of PvP Volunteer Start Function for Small Groups
A function has been added that allows PvP volunteer missions to start when there are 2 or more players in the room.
※Missing participants will be filled by Sinner NPCs

・Change in default value of application authority for Cooperative Volunteers
The default setting for the application authority of cooperative volunteers has been changed from "Host Only" to "Everyone."

・Adjustment of Success Rate for Modular Synthesis
The success rate for modular synthesis has been adjusted, making it easier to strengthen modules.

・Adjustment of Attack Hit Display for SR and AR Weapons
The damage display position for SR and AR weapon hits has been adjusted to prevent overlap.

・Addition of Accessory Voice Language Switch Function
A language switch function for Accessory’s voices has been added to the " Window on Liberty > Auditory Language Change Request" menu.
※Accessory’s voices support both Japanese and English languages.
※To correctly play the customized response voices, you need to re-enter the dialogue in the selected language.

・Additional Specs for the "Spider Thread" Status Effect
When affected by the "Spider Thread" status effect, players can now escape from the restrained state more quickly by pressing buttons.

・Adjustment to the Spawn Frequency of Shielded Abductors
The spawn frequency of shielded Abductors has been adjusted.

・Adjustment to Dodge Action Performance
Dodge action performance has been adjusted. Additionally, the window for transitioning from getting up after being downed to a dodge has been extended.

・Adjustment to Dionaea's Attack Hitbox
The hitbox for Dionaea's running attack and gliding attack has been adjusted.

・Feature to hide menu displays in online multiplayer rooms 
Added a feature to hide menu displays in online multiplayer rooms. Pressing the R2/ZR/RT button will now hide various menu displays.

・【Steam】Addition of Thorn Aim Assist On/Off Option
An option menu has been added to turn on/off the Thorn aim assist feature.

【Upcoming Update Plans】
The following adjustments and additions are planned for future updates.

・Weapon balance adjustments
・Addition of a feature to view TIPS at any time
・Ability to bring substitute Accessories to volunteering at any time
・Display adjustments for the Modular Selection screen
・Addition of an option to turn on/off dash function by holding the Dodge button


We appreciate your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.

notes.title: Notice Regarding the FREEDOM WARS Remastered Update of March 4th
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered. 
We would like to inform you about the contents of the updated released on March 4th, as well as other upcoming updates. 


【About the Update】 
▼Applicable Platforms 
Steam® version of FREEDOM WARS Remastered 


▼Update Versions 
Steam®：1.06 


▼Updated Contents 
■Bug Fixes	 
・Some of the settings were not being reflected after preparing a loadout at the transporter screen right before starting an operation 
Fixed the bug preventing some of the changes from being reflected after a time up occurred when preparing a loadout right before the start of an operation (affected items：Modules and Augmentations）. 

・Game crashes inside the Request Cooperation rooms 
Fixed the bug causing the game to freeze at the Request Cooperation rooms when the host changed the room comments continuously. 

・【Steam®】Inability to progress past the story events of CODE 6. 
Fixed the bug affecting the character’s movement during the story events of CODE 6 when playing under certain system settings, preventing players from getting past the story events. 

・【Steam®】Inability to change the direction of charged heavy melee attacks when using mouse & keyboard. 
Fixed the bug preventing players from changing the direction of weak heavy melee attacks when using mouse & keyboard controls. 

・【PS4®】Inability to choose some spawning points at a certain map in Vs. Operations 
Fixed the bug preventing players from selecting spawning points G and E during Vs. Operations at the “Large Scale Facilities”. 

・Other bug fixes 
Fixed other minor bugs. 


■Specification adjustments/changes 
・Adjustments around the respawn of Small Abductors, Sinners, Accessories and from On High 
Extended the time it takes for Small Abductors, Sinners, Accessories and from On High to respawn after defeating them during certain operations. 

・Adjustments on the behavior of the Accessories 
Adjusted the behavior of the Accessories when attacking. 

・Addition of a Dash move by holding down the Dodge button 
Added a Dash move that can be executed by holding down the Dodge button. 

・Hit detection adjustments for the Abductor’s attacks 
Adjusted the hit detection of the Large Abductors’ “Gatling Gun” weapons, 

・Added a feature that allows turning Private Rooms into Custom Rooms 
Added a new feature that allows turning the Private Rooms originally created for co-op operations into Custom Rooms. 

・Addition of the Room Comments 
Added a new feature that allows players to configure Room Comments in the Request Cooperation option. 

・【Steam®】Matchmaking adjustments 
Adjusted the matchmaking conditions of the online multiplayer. 


【Upcoming Updates】 
We plan to fix the following bugs/specifications in the upcoming updates. 

・Way of getting the Retribution Missions 
We plan to adjust the ways in which players can obtain Retribution Missions. 

・Chances of obtaining rare resources during the Retribution Missions 
We plan to adjust the players’ chances of obtaining the rare resources that only appear at the Retribution Missions. 

・Weapon balance adjustments 
We plan to improve the efficiency of certain weapons. 

・Adjustment of the severing attacks 
We plan to improve the damage inflicted by the severing attacks. 

・Adjustments to the Modular Synthesis’ success rate 
We plan to make some adjustments to facilitate the creation of high level (XL)Modules. 

・Sound effect crashes when locking on with Ranged Weapons 
We plan to fix the sound effect bug causing the sound to remain active after locking on with Ranged weapons. 

・Issues during Polearm charge attacks 
We plan to fix the bug preventing the players from aiming in the middle of Polearm charge attacks. 

・Positioning adjustments to the damage display of some weapons 
We plan to adjust the positioning of the damage displays that appear when using AR weapons, so that the one that the damage values from the impacts and explosions do not pile up on top of each other. 

・Notification Log issues during Abductor part destructions  
We plan to fix the bug causing the Notification Log to show a message stating that a weapon cannot be obtained during Abductor part destructions. 

・Addition of an option to disable the aim assist feature of the Thorns 
We plan to add an option that allows users to disable the aim assist feature of the Thorns. 

・Changes to the settings used for the creation of Request Cooperation rooms 
We plan to change the default joining option that appears when creating a Request Cooperation room, from “Host Only” to “Everyone”. 


Thank you for your continued support of “FREEDOM WARS Remastered”.

notes.title: Notice Regarding the FREEDOM WARS Remastered Update, February 7th
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.  
We would like to inform you about the contents of Update Version 1.4, released on February 7th, as well as upcoming updates.    

[About the Update]    
▼Update Versions  
Steam®: 1.04    

【Update Contents for Version 1.4】  
■ Bug Fixes  
・Unresponsiveness in Multiplayer Lobby  
Fixed a bug where players would become unresponsive in the online multiplayer lobby if another player joined after they had set their status to READY but before deployment.    

・Screen Freezing During Matching in Private Rooms  
Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, canceling the matching process as the host in a private room would cause the guest's game screen to freeze.  
  
・Issue with Operation Start Circle  
Fixed a bug where multiple players interacting with the same Operation Start Circle simultaneously in a Co-op Room would prevent them from setting their status to "READY.    

・Items Dropping from Enemies That Shouldn't  
Fixed a bug where items that should not drop were appearing as drops when defeating enemy characters.  
  
・No Reinforcements in Operation  
Fixed a bug, when playing online multiplayer operation where enemy reinforcements would not appear, preventing the operation from being completed.  
  
・Inability to Progress Due to Added Sentence for Natalia  
Fixed a bug where the screen would darken, preventing progression, when Natalia’s sentence was added in the solitary confinement scene.    

・Certain Operations Repeating Unintentionally  
Fixed a bug where certain special Operations would not disappear from the Operation list after completion, allowing them to be repeatedly played.    

・Equipping Augmentations Beyond Cost Limit  
If a player equips a augmentation that exceeds the cost limit, the augmentation will now be automatically unequipped.    

・Deadly Sinner Icon  
Fixed a bug where the "Deadly Sinner" icon displayed above a player's head was not visible on other players' screens.    

・Ranking Board Update  
Fixed a bug where, immediately after transferring to a new panopticon, information regarding city-state status and the ranking board would not update.    

・Ally Character Behavior Fix  
Fixed a bug during operations where ally characters would exhibit abnormal behavior while carrying citizens.    

・Other Bug Fixes  
Various other bug fixes have been applied.    


■Specification adjustments/changes  
・[Willonite: Minimum Purity] GDPP Value  
The GDPP value earned upon delivering the corresponding item has been changed.  
  
・Adjustment to Thorn Gauge Consumption During Revival  
When performing a revival by approaching a character, the Thorn Gauge will no longer be consumed.  
Note: If the revival is done by shooting thorns from a distance, the Thorn Gauge will still be consumed as before.    

・Behavior When Colliding with Obstacles While Carrying Citizens  
During Operations, the staggering behavior when colliding with obstacles while carrying citizens has been shortened.  
  
・Attack Hitbox for Heavy Melee [Mimas] [Caliburn] Type Weapons  
The attack hitbox for the [Power Attack Charge 1] of the Heavy Melee [Mimas] and [Caliburn] type weapons has been adjusted to ensure that the hitbox now matches the visual appearance of the attack.  
  
・Power Attack Adjustment During Thorn Connection  
The system has been fixed so that when performing a power attack while connected to the Thorn with the Heavy Melee, instead of triggering a special attack that couldn’t be charged, a normal attack that can be charged will now occur. Additionally, performing a power attack during a Thorn connection will now cancel the Thorn connection for all weapons.  

・After a successful Operation, the chat was previously unavailable until the result screen.  
This has been changed, and chat can now be used during the period between a successful operation and the result screen.  
  
・Regarding the attack judgment of Dionaea's [Dragon Beam]  
Adjustments have been made to the attack hitbox of the [Dragon Beam] fired by the large Abductor Dionaea.  
  
・Displaying Equipped Items on the Modular Synthesis Screen  
On the Modular Synthesis screen, all modules currently equipped on weapons will now display the [E] mark to indicate they are equipped.    

・Emote Behavior Changes  
Various adjustments have been made to the behavior of emotes, improving their ease of use.

  
【Upcoming Update Plans】  
The following bugs/specifications will be fixed in future updates.  
  
・Japanese Character Name Input  
Character and accessory name entry will be updated to allow input in Japanese (Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji).    

・Critical Multiplier for Mutated Weapons  
The critical hits for mutated weapons were occurring at an unintended multiplier, so this will be fixed.  
  
・Damage Display Issue  
We plan to fix a bug where the effect was not reflected in the damage display even though a defensive augmentation was equipped.  
  
・Health augmentation Issue  
We plan to fix a bug where the effects of [Health Enhancement] augmentations are not being properly applied in-game.  
  
・Voice Volume Adjustment  
We will adjust the volume balance to improve audibility, as some in-game voices were difficult to hear in certain situations.  
  
・Improved stability   
We plan to fix a bug that causes crashes and freezes in certain situations.    

・Other Issues  
We plan to fix and adjust various other bugs and specifications.    
  

Thank you for your continued support of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.

Return to Panopticon with the 10th anniversary remaster of FREEDOM WARS.

In the distant future, humanity is in a struggle to survive. Pollution has devastated the planet, and the remnants of humanity are divided amongst city-sized prisons called Panopticons. So scarce are resources that living itself is a crime and those born are immediately given a million years of prison time. 

Dubbed “Sinners” the only option other than awaiting death in prison is to fight for freedom with allies for resources, to rescue citizens from abduction by rival enemies, or take up arms against other enemy Sinners.
